land_cells: SELECT DISTINCT e.h0, e.h8, e.h9, e.h10 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') e JOIN ({{AOI10}}) a ON e.h0 = a.h0 AND e.h10 = a.h10
land: SELECT c.h0, c.h8, c.h9, c.h10, h3_cell_area(c.h10, 'km^2') AS area_km2, COALESCE(w.w1 + w.w2, 0) AS w12, COALESCE(w.w3 + w.w4, 0) AS w34, COALESCE(w.w1 + w.w2 + w.w3 + w.w4, 0) AS wc FROM ({{CELLS}}) c LEFT JOIN read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/conserved-areas-terrestrial-2025/hex-weights/h0=*/data_0.parquet') w ON w.h0 = c.h0 AND w.h10 = c.h10
land_manager: SELECT c.h0, c.h8, c.h9, c.h10, h3_cell_area(c.h10, 'km^2') AS area_km2, COALESCE((w.w1 + w.w2) * m.s12, 0) AS w12, COALESCE((w.w3 + w.w4) * m.s34, 0) AS w34, COALESCE(w.w1 + w.w2 + w.w3 + w.w4, 0) AS wc FROM ({{CELLS}}) c LEFT JOIN read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/conserved-areas-terrestrial-2025/hex-weights/h0=*/data_0.parquet') w ON w.h0 = c.h0 AND w.h10 = c.h10 LEFT JOIN (SELECT u.h0, u.h10, SUM(CASE WHEN {{UNITS}} THEN COALESCE(u.Final_g1_p, 0) + COALESCE(u.Final_g2_p, 0) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(u.Final_g1_p, 0) + COALESCE(u.Final_g2_p, 0)), 0) AS s12, SUM(CASE WHEN {{UNITS}} THEN COALESCE(u.Final_g3_p, 0) + COALESCE(u.Final_g4_p, 0) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(u.Final_g3_p, 0) + COALESCE(u.Final_g4_p, 0)), 0) AS s34 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/conserved-areas-terrestrial-2025/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') u SEMI JOIN ({{CELLS}}) k ON u.h0 = k.h0 AND u.h10 = k.h10 GROUP BY u.h0, u.h10) m ON m.h0 = c.h0 AND m.h10 = c.h10

jurisdictions.label: Ecoregions

jurisdictions.aoi: SELECT DISTINCT h0, h8 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') WHERE CA_Ecoregi = '{{ID}}'
jurisdictions.aoi10: SELECT DISTINCT h0, h8, h10 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') WHERE CA_Ecoregi = '{{ID}}'
jurisdictions.list: SELECT CA_Ecoregi AS id, CA_Ecoregi AS name, MIN(ST_XMin(geom)) AS xmin, MIN(ST_YMin(geom)) AS ymin, MAX(ST_XMax(geom)) AS xmax, MAX(ST_YMax(geom)) AS ymax FROM read_parquet('s3://public-ca30x30/ecoregion.parquet') GROUP BY CA_Ecoregi ORDER BY CA_Ecoregi
